title: Filing: Meta reports ~$825B in lease and contract commitments, up from nearly $700B in July; off-balance-sheet leases total $355.7B through 2036; META drops 5%+ (Sarah Frier/Bloomberg)
summary: Sarah Frier / Bloomberg: Filing: Meta reports ~$825B in lease and contract commitments, up from nearly $700B in July; off-balance-sheet leases total $355.7B through 2036; META drops 5%+ — Meta Platforms Inc. said it has agreed to spend about $825 billion in the future on various leases and contracts …
